exposure: Pregnant women diagnosed with uterine fibroids during pregnancy
cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with uterine fibroids during pregnancy
finding: Myomectomy during cesarean section can be performed safely without increasing peripartum maternal morbidities, although it may prolong operative time and postoperative hospital stay.
mod_finding: The study found that myomectomy performed during cesarean section was safe and did not increase maternal morbidities, although it did prolong operating time and postoperative hospital stay.
